blocks.heading: E-Commerce that *Drives Revenue*
blocks.lead: Build, optimize, and scale your online store with our comprehensive e-commerce solutions. From Shopify and WooCommerce to marketplace integrations and conversion optimization.

header.title: E-Commerce solutions *that sell*
header.subtitle: Turn visitors into customers with optimized stores, seamless checkout, and smart integrations.

items.title: Shopify & WooCommerce
items.body: Full e-commerce platform builds with payment processing, shipping, inventory management, and customer portals.

items.title: Marketplace Integration
items.body: List and manage products on Amazon, Etsy, eBay, or industry-specific marketplaces with centralized inventory.

items.title: Subscription Models
items.body: Recurring revenue platforms for service businesses, communities, and content creators with automated billing.

items.title: Digital Products
items.body: Online courses, downloadable guides, paid webinars, and community platforms to monetize your expertise.

items.title: Conversion Optimization
items.body: A/B testing, funnel analysis, checkout optimization, and UX improvements to maximize revenue.

items.title: Payment Gateways
items.body: Integration with Stripe, PayPal, Square, and local payment methods for seamless transactions worldwide.

header.title: E-Commerce done *right*
header.subtitle: We build stores that convert visitors into buyers and keep them coming back.

items.title: Strategy & Planning
items.body: We analyze your market, competitors, and target audience to design a store strategy that maximizes conversions and revenue.

items.title: Platform Selection
items.body: We recommend the right platform (Shopify, WooCommerce, or custom) based on your needs, budget, and scalability requirements.

items.title: Design & Development
items.body: We build a beautiful, responsive store with optimized checkout, fast loading, and seamless user experience across all devices.

items.title: Integration & Launch
items.body: We connect payment gateways, shipping providers, inventory systems, and launch your store with full testing and training.

blocks.heading: Ready to sell *online?*
blocks.body: Book a free e-commerce consultation. We'll help you choose the right platform and design a store that converts visitors into customers.
